basis: Developmental delay, obesity and eye/vision anomalies are defining features; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Hypotonia alone does not establish muscle disease.

decisions.ocular: primary: eye/vision abnormalities are explicitly defining features, supported by strabismus in 30-79%.

basis: Adrenal cortisol excess; proximal amyotrophy/osteoporosis and dermal striae/fragility each occur in 30-79%. Hypertension and kidney stones are separately diagnosed complications.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension occurs in 30-79%, but is a separately diagnosed secondary condition; direct cardiovascular tissue injury is not established.

basis: Atypical Meigs syndrome characteristically combines a benign pelvic tumor with pleural effusion without ascites; pleural fluid occupation defines it. Ovarian tissue has no axis.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: pleural effusion without ascites characterizes atypical/incomplete Meigs syndrome and directly occupies the pleural space.

basis: Malignant clival bone tumor; direct cranial nerve compression produces neuropathy in roughly half of patients, particularly abducens palsy.

decisions.neurologic: involved: cranial neuropathy from direct tumor compression occurs in roughly 50%; this represents nerve dysfunction rather than proximity alone.

basis: Scleral inflammation extending into the cornea; sclerokeratitis is predominantly immune-mediated, with infectious causes forming a minority.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: sclerokeratitis is predominantly immune-mediated ocular inflammation; infectious forms also qualify for this mechanism axis.

basis: Intrinsic neutrophil oxidative-burst dysfunction; granulomatous intestinal inflammation affects roughly 30-50% in CGD. Secondary organ infections are separately diagnosed.

decisions.haematologic: primary: this is an intrinsic functional disease of blood phagocytes, with defective neutrophil oxidative burst documented in 7/7 patients.

basis: Inherited heme synthesis disorders; skin and neurologic injury vary substantially by subtype, without an established majority across this umbrella. Hepatic synthesis does not imply liver damage.

decisions.dermatologic: none: cutaneous injury defines particular subtypes; the evidence does not establish that it affects most patients across the inherited porphyria umbrella.

basis: CNS myelin destruction defines the organ axis. Immune-mediated disease predominates across patients, including both listed subtypes, MS and MOG-antibody-associated disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: immune-mediated disorders predominate across this umbrella and both listed subtypes; the umbrella rule requires applicability to most patients, not every cause.

basis: Auricular and mandibular malformations define the syndrome; hearing impairment in 6/6. Narrow mouth and glossoptosis do not establish digestive tissue injury; apnea alone adds no pulmonary axis.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: narrow mouth (8/10) and glossoptosis (4/9) describe craniofacial anatomy without established direct gastrointestinal injury or functional loss.

basis: Human Newcastle virus infection characteristically localizes to the conjunctiva. Respiratory and intestinal symptoms do not establish additional common organ damage.

decisions.ocular: primary: conjunctivitis represents characteristic direct conjunctival infection; the exclusion of transient signs does not remove the primary site of infection.
